title: AI Estate
description: Estate overview: headline spend/token KPIs, cloud spend and tokens by provider and model, the local GPU box (power, utilization, engine, throughput, latency) and pipeline health. Provider / Model / Token kind dropdowns drive every cloud panel; provider colours are fixed dashboard-wide.

list.name: provider
list.label: Provider
list.description: Cloud-side providers with any usage in the last 30 days (hermes excluded -- it has its own attribution panel).

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Models with any usage in the last 30 days under the selected provider(s).

list.name: kind
list.label: Token kind
list.description: Which token kinds the Cloud Tokens panels count. All = every kind summed (cache reads usually dominate); pick output to see generated tokens only. Cost panels ignore this -- cost series carry no kind label.

panels.description: Cloud spend since local midnight, all selected providers/models (hermes excluded -- see the anti-double-count rule). Sparkline: the last 14 local days, today last. Day-granular counters use the forward-looking daily delta (see Daily Spend by Provider).

Cloud spend since the start of the local calendar month (panel pinned to now/M; the baseline is read with @ ${__from:date:seconds}). The now-side looks ahead one hourly step so the tile includes the newest collector push. Range query reduced to its last point -- VictoriaMetrics' instant path can mis-evaluate this max_over_time + large-offset shape (README troubleshooting).

Where this month's spend is heading. From day 7 on: linear run-rate, spend so far x (days in month / days elapsed). In the first 7 days: spend so far + remaining days x the average daily spend of the last 7 days -- a straight line through a few hours of spend is noise (backtest: on 1 Aug the linear projection read $0 against a $9,000 month; this reads $6,340, and it converges on the actual total at month end). Bursty weeks still move it; it is a projection, not a budget. Sparkline: the forecast as it evolved through the month (each step divides by that step's own elapsed time). days_in_month() is evaluated on a timestamp three days into the local month so the UTC-based function names the right month.

targets.expr: ((sum(max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset -$__interval) - (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] @ ${__from:date:seconds}) or (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset -$__interval)*0)))) * (days_in_month(vector(${__from:date:seconds} + 259200)) * 86400) / (time() + $__interval_ms / 1000 - ${__from:date:seconds}) and on() (vector(time() + $__interval_ms / 1000 - ${__from:date:seconds}) >= 604800)) or ((sum(max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset -$__interval) - (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] @ ${__from:date:seconds}) or (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset -$__interval)*0)))) + clamp_min((days_in_month(vector(${__from:date:seconds} + 259200)) * 86400) - (time() + $__interval_ms / 1000 - ${__from:date:seconds}), 0) / 86400 * (sum(max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset -$__interval) - (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset 7d) or (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset -$__interval)*0)))) / 7 and on() (vector(time() + $__interval_ms / 1000 - ${__from:date:seconds}) < 604800))

panels.description: Cloud tokens since the start of the local month, all kinds selected in Token kind (cache reads usually dominate). Same @-anchored, look-ahead subtraction as Spend this month.

Share of prompt-side tokens served from the provider's prompt cache this month: cache_read / (input + cache_read + cache_write). Ignores the Token kind dropdown (it is a ratio of kinds). Sparkline: the month-to-date ratio as the month progressed.

targets.expr: sum(max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind="cache_read"}[400d] offset -$__interval) - (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind="cache_read"}[400d] @ ${__from:date:seconds}) or (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind="cache_read"}[400d] offset -$__interval)*0))) / sum(max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_write"}[400d] offset -$__interval) - (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_write"}[400d] @ ${__from:date:seconds}) or (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_write"}[400d] offset -$__interval)*0)))

panels.description: nvidia-smi board power on the GPU box: 5-minute averages over the last 6 hours; the value is the latest 5-minute average, or 'offline' when the box has stopped reporting (vmagent runs on the box, so an outage leaves no samples at all).

Prompt tokens computed + tokens generated by the local inference server since local midnight, whichever engine is resident (vLLM, SGLang or llama.cpp -- one __name__ regex covers all three; prefix-cache hits are not counted as work). Real scraped counters, so increase() is fine here.

How many pipeline signals are down: the tokscale and openrouter collector lanes (a success in the last 20 minutes) and the GPU exporter scrape (last 2 minutes). A signal that has gone silent but was seen in the last 30 days counts as down. Sparkline: the last 6 hours. Details in Estate Timeline and Collector Lanes at the bottom.

targets.expr: (sum((1 - last_over_time(aiobs_lane_up[20m])) or (last_over_time(aiobs_lane_up[30d]) * 0 + 1)) or vector(0)) + (sum((1 - max(last_over_time(up{job="gpu"}[2m]))) or (max(last_over_time(up{job="gpu"}[30d])) * 0 + 1)) or vector(0))

panels.title: Daily Spend by Provider (30d)
panels.description: Stacked daily client-side USD cost per cloud provider; each bar is one LOCAL day and the last bar is today so far. Hermes is excluded (its client view mixes local and cloud-routed traffic; it has its own panel). Counters are pushed one sample per day (stamped 23:59:59 local) plus live points for today, so the query is a forward-looking two-point subtraction: at each local-midnight step D it takes max_over_time(...[400d] offset -1d) minus the counter as of D, with a label-preserving X or (X*0) fallback. The earlier backward form (offset 1d) put every bar one day late and never showed today -- verified 2026-09-27 against a raw /api/v1/export ground truth (Sep 24 = $1,992 sat under 09/25). Never increase(): verified up to ~27x off on this data. Colours are fixed per provider across the whole dashboard. Filtered by Provider / Model.

panels.title: Cost Month-to-Date
panels.description: USD spend since the local month start per cloud provider, largest first (sort_desc). @ ${__from:date:seconds} anchors the month start exactly (offset $__range on a step grid landed inside the previous month's last day); the now-side looks ahead one hourly step so the bars include the newest push. Range query reduced to its last point. Filtered by Provider / Model.

panels.title: Daily Tokens by Provider (30d)
panels.description: Stacked daily token counts per cloud provider for the selected Token kind(s); one bar per local day, today last. Same forward-looking two-point subtraction as Daily Spend by Provider. With Token kind = All, cache reads dominate -- pick output or input to see the work behind the spend.

panels.title: Tokens Month-to-Date
panels.description: Tokens since the local month start per cloud provider, largest first. Same @-anchored subtraction as Cost Month-to-Date. Filtered by Provider / Model / Token kind.

panels.title: Cost per Day by Model (30d)
panels.description: Stacked daily USD cost per (provider, model), one bar per local day, today last. Legend is ranked by 30-day total. The 12 largest series are kept with MetricsQL topk_max(), which picks ONE series set for the whole range (Prometheus topk() re-ranks per step and makes stacked bars flicker). Each model wears a shade of its provider's colour (Grafana shades mode), so the provider mix reads at a glance and the legend/tooltip name the model. Pick a model in the Model dropdown to isolate it.

targets.expr: topk_max(12, sum by (provider,model)(max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset -1d) - (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d]) or (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset -1d)*0))) > 0)

panels.title: Daily Tokens by Model (30d)
panels.description: Stacked daily tokens per (provider, model) for the selected Token kind(s), one bar per local day, today last; legend ranked by 30-day total. topk_max(12, ...) keeps one stable series set for the whole range; models wear shades of their provider's colour.

targets.expr: topk_max(12, sum by (provider,model)(max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"$kind"}[400d] offset -1d) - (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"$kind"}[400d]) or (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"$kind"}[400d] offset -1d)*0))) > 0)

panels.title: Model Breakdown (30d)
panels.description: Every (provider, model) pair with cloud usage in the last 30 days (hermes excluded -- a ranked table invites cross-provider summing by eye, which recreates the double-count the anti-double-count rule prevents), ranked by cost. Tokens follow the Token kind dropdown; Output is output tokens only; Share of Spend is each row's share of the 30-day cost of everything selected; $ / 1M Tokens is cost divided by the Tokens column (blended across the selected kinds). Each column is the same two-point max_over_time subtraction as the other counter panels (offset 30d), issued as range queries in table format and reduced to their last point (merge -> sort by time -> group by provider+model, last -> rename -> drop zero rows -> sort by cost -> top 20). Evaluated on a 1-minute grid over a hidden 10-minute panel range so the value shown is within a minute of now; the 30-day window comes from the offset. Column headers sort and filter.

targets.expr: (sum by (provider,model)(max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d]) - (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset 30d) or (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d])*0)))) / scalar(sum(sum by (provider,model)(max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d]) - (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset 30d) or (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d])*0)))))

(sum by (provider,model)(max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d]) - (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d] offset 30d) or (max_over_time(aiobs_cost_usd_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model"}[400d])*0)))) / (sum by (provider,model)(max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"$kind"}[400d]) - (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"$kind"}[400d] offset 30d) or (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{origin="client",provider!="hermes",provider=~"$provider",model=~"$model",kind=~"$kind"}[400d])*0)))) * 1e6

panels.title: Serving
panels.description: Which engine and model the inference server on the GPU box is running right now (vLLM, SGLang or llama.cpp; llama.cpp exposes no model label). Offline = no engine metrics in the last 2 minutes.

panels.title: Inference Engine
panels.description: Live load and cache state of the resident engine: requests running and queued, KV-cache occupancy (vLLM kv_cache_usage_perc / SGLang token_usage), prefix-cache hit rate (cached prompt tokens / prompt tokens) and completed requests -- the last two over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Local vs Cloud Output (Today)
panels.description: Output tokens since local midnight: generated on the local GPU (any engine) versus returned by cloud providers (client-side, hermes excluded), and the local share. Cloud side uses the @-anchored day subtraction, not a rolling 24h window -- on day-granular counters a 1d offset from 'now' counted yesterday AND today.

panels.title: GPU Power
panels.description: Board power draw on the GPU box against its enforced power limit (dashed). The axis keeps the whole power budget in view, so idle reads as idle.

panels.title: GPU Utilization & VRAM
panels.description: SM utilization and VRAM occupancy, both as a share of capacity on one 0-100% axis (VRAM sits near the engine's reservation, e.g. vLLM gpu_memory_utilization, whenever a model is loaded).

panels.title: GPU Vitals
panels.description: Energy since local midnight plus the latest die temperature, fan duty, graphics clock and VRAM in use on the GPU box (panel pinned to now/d). Energy is MetricsQL integrate() over the actual power samples, in kWh -- deliberately NOT avg_over_time(...) * $__range_s, which extrapolates the sampled average across unsampled hours and over-reported ~3.4x on a partial-coverage day (drifting DOWNWARD as idle samples accumulated); caught 2026-08-29 against a raw /api/v1/export trapezoid ground truth (integrate() matched within 0.25%). integrate() wraps the raw selector: integrate(max(m)[..]) is an implicit subquery that resamples and read 0.85% high (2026-09-27); and it sums 5-minute windows, because a whole-range integrate() range query carries the last reading through an outage (read 27% high for 10 Sep). Range queries reduced to their last value.

panels.title: Generation Throughput
panels.description: Decode tokens per second across whichever engine is resident (one __name__ regex over vLLM, SGLang and both llama.cpp spellings; keep_metric_names prevents duplicate-series collisions). $__rate_interval widens with the step so long ranges average instead of aliasing.

panels.title: Prompt Throughput
panels.description: Prompt tokens per second the engine actually computed (prefill work), across engines -- prefix-cache hits are left out: vLLM and SGLang prompt totals include them (vLLM counted cache hits as prefill about 5.7x over) while llama.cpp's do not, so each engine's computed-only counter is used. Split from generation on purpose: prefill runs 10-30x faster than decode and would flatten it on a shared axis.

panels.title: Latency (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Time to first token and end-to-end request latency from the engine's own histograms (vLLM and SGLang expose both; llama.cpp has no latency histogram). Gaps mean no requests in that window.

panels.title: Estate Timeline
panels.description: History of every moving part over the dashboard range: which inference engine was resident on the GPU box, whether the LLM server and GPU exporter answered their scrapes (worst state per step), and whether each collector lane succeeded (a push every 10 minutes; 20-minute window). Empty = no data at all -- the box or collector was off.

panels.title: Collector Lanes
panels.description: Current state of each data path. Status: a collector lane is up when it succeeded in the last 20 minutes; a scrape is up when the last scrape in 2 minutes answered (a signal seen in the last 30 days but silent now reads down). Last seen: time since the lane's last success (aiobs_lane_last_success_timestamp) or since the last sample actually arrived (tlast_over_time) -- green under 15 minutes, amber under an hour, red beyond. Health gauges are wrapped in last_over_time because a bare instant selector's ~5-minute staleness lookback is shorter than the collector's 600 s push cadence.

targets.expr: max by (signal)(label_replace(last_over_time(aiobs_lane_up[20m]) or (last_over_time(aiobs_lane_up[30d]) * 0), "signal", "$1 lane", "lane", "(.*)")) or max by (signal)(label_replace(label_replace(last_over_time(up{job=~"gpu|llm"}[2m]) or (last_over_time(up{job=~"gpu|llm"}[30d]) * 0), "signal", "GPU exporter", "job", "gpu"), "signal", "LLM server", "job", "llm"))

max by (signal)(label_replace(time() - last_over_time(aiobs_lane_last_success_timestamp[30d]), "signal", "$1 lane", "lane", "(.*)")) or label_set(time() - max(tlast_over_time(nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts[30d])), "signal", "GPU exporter") or label_set(time() - max(tlast_over_time({__name__=~"vllm:num_requests_running|sglang:num_running_reqs|llamacpp:requests_processing"}[30d])), "signal", "LLM server")

panels.title: Hermes Client View (30d)
panels.description: Daily tokens by Hermes model/profile as tokscale sees Hermes on the client side -- a mix of local-served and cloud-routed traffic, so it is never summed into any cross-provider total here (anti-double-count rule). One bar per local day, today last (same forward-looking two-point subtraction as the cloud panels, not increase()).

targets.expr: topk_max(12, sum by (model)(max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{provider="hermes",origin="client"}[400d] offset -1d) - (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{provider="hermes",origin="client"}[400d]) or (max_over_time(aiobs_tokens_total{provider="hermes",origin="client"}[400d] offset -1d)*0))) > 0)
